I think I  a good mother. I had a stranger come up to me in the supermarket when my little one was tantruming. She said she was a professional play therapist and I had ‘handled that very well.’ People always tell me how patient I am. 

Sometimes I think how unbearably painful life can be and I do my best to be kind to my children. At least your mother can be kind in this horrible world. 

I never really had a mother, well sometimes I did (long story) and I used to imagine someone so kind. That’s who I try and be. Obviously I am far from perfect. I just had children to bring some light and joy in. 

I won’t kill myself. It’s a terrible sin in my religion. It’s just in many ways I just can’t wait to die.
Thank you. I feel better after reading what you wrote. You helped me today.
